question: Should OpenClaw expose Anthropic advisor support through `params.advisor` before raw server-tool replay, usage accounting, and provider/model policy are completed?
rationale: The implementation quality is separable from the product contract: enabling a provider beta changes config behavior, auth/header routing, replay state, and billing semantics for existing Anthropic users.

options.title: Require provider-state support first
options.body: Preserve raw server-tool blocks, pruning, replay, current usage semantics, and explicit direct/OAuth/proxy policy before merging the feature surface.

options.title: Accept display-only beta behavior
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally land a narrower display-only beta with documented limitations and follow-up tracking for encrypted replay and usage semantics.

options.title: Pause for broader server-tools direction
options.body: Pause or redirect this PR if advisor support should wait for the broader Anthropic server-tools tracker or a model-agnostic plugin path.

recommendation.title: Require provider-state support first
recommendation.body: Preserve raw server-tool blocks, pruning, replay, current usage semantics, and explicit direct/OAuth/proxy policy before merging the feature surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal points to recent shared Anthropic provider transport/helper ownership.
